description: A blue benzo tab that files the sharp edges off a bad night.

overdose.message: You lie down to rest your eyes for just a second, and never open them.

phases.end_message: The calm wears thin and the worries file back in.
phases.peak_message: The panic unclenches. Whatever it was, it can wait.

effects.take_line: You slip a {name} tab under your tongue.

withdrawal.message: Your nerves are live wires again. You remember exactly what fixes that.

stages.easing: You get twenty minutes of something adjacent to sleep and come out of it less rested than you went in.
stages.onset: The edges lull was filing come back on, all at once, at the same time.
stages.peak: Your hands won't sit still on a table and your jaw aches from a night of doing something you weren't awake for.
stages.rising: Sounds arrive at full volume with nothing in front of them. A door two rooms away is an event.
stages.tail: You can be in a room with people again. You're still counting the exits, and you weren't before.

name: lull
